name: Suou Natsukage
source: A boy who plays Sky-Sea-Run. Used to change clothes but he practices daily, and it's a pain to do, so he stopped doing so. This means he's always sopping wet. His favorite ice cream flavor is choco-banana.
translation: A boy who plays Sky-Sea-Run. Used to change clothes but he practices daily, and it's a pain to do, so he stopped doing so. This means he's always sopping wet. His favorite ice cream flavor is choco-banana.
